title: No smoking in child care facilities.
bodyText: Smoking shall be prohibited in all group child care homes, group child care centers, and family child care homes during their hours of operation.
bodyHtml: [§346-158]  No smoking in child care facilities.  Smoking shall be prohibited in all group child care homes, group child care centers, and family child care homes during their hours of operation. [L 1993, c 68, §1]
